why: No major reviewer or authority appears. Every roundup is a Plex/transcoding listicle that treats direct play as a footnote and steers to $600+ Intel boxes; the one page naming a cheap direct-play box (accessorytested) is an affiliate list with unverifiable testing. Two forum threads are unreadable, one is a 2022 Q&A about a $700 unit, and the rest are off-target Infuse app pages. A page that drops transcoding entirely and ranks the cheapest NAS units by throughput for Infuse direct play with current prices would stand out.
